::: {#hero-heading}

Research areas include Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN), Vision-Language Action (VLA), World Action Model (WAM), and AI Agent.

## Background

- 2026-Present: Master of Science, Nanyang Technological University, specializing in Machine Learning, under supervision of Prof. [Lihua Xie](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Fmrv3J8AAAAJ&hl=en).

- 2021-2025: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours), Chongqing University of Technology, majoring in Computer Science and Technology, under supervision of Prof. [Xiaofei Zhu](https://www.atailab.cn/).

## Internship Experience

::: {.project-header}
[Lenovo (Shanghai) Information Technology Co., Ltd. (LR Robotics Algorithm) — Embodied AI Research Intern (Robotics)]{.project-title}
[2026.05-2026.08]{.project-date}
:::
::: {.project-desc}
Leveraging the Lenovo Morningstar robot as the platform, a collaborative intelligent agent system has been constructed, comprising the task-planning "mastermind" NavAgent and the dual-system navigator InternVLA-N1-DualVLN. NavAgent utilizes the LangGraph state machine and MCP to orchestrate the ROS2 toolkit, handling global 
task parsing, memory storage, telemetry self-checks, and anomaly diagnosis. DualVLN manages specific motion generation: System 2 (2 Hz; fine-tuned QwenVL-2.5) predicts 2D pixel sub-goals, while System 1 (30 Hz; NextDiT) outputs high-frequency physical trajectories. SR increased by 10.1%, SPL increased by 6.7%, NE decreased by 17.6%, and StR decreased by 32.5%.
:::

## Project Experience
::: {.project-header}
[Fine-tuning and Closed-loop Evaluation of SmolVLA Robot Fruit-Grasping Strategies Based on Multimodal Synthetic Data](https://github.com/qiyuanlanniao/Franka_Fruit_Pick){.project-title}
[2026.07-Present]{.project-date}
:::
::: {.project-desc}
This project established an end-to-end development pipeline—spanning multi-objective synthetic data generation, VLA policy fine-tuning, and closed-loop evaluation—on AMD GPUs (ROCm). Leveraging the Genesis IK expert controller, the team autonomously generated and aggregated a standard LeRobot multimodal dataset comprising 150 episodes (over 30,000 frames) featuring three categories of geometric fruit. Building on this, SmolVLA underwent imitation learning fine-tuning, achieving a 76% success rate in end-to-end closed-loop placement tasks within environments characterized by cross-domain visual and physical disturbances (an 8% improvement over models without domain randomization).
:::

::: {.project-header}
[OmniVLN: Open-Set Instance-Level 3D Semantic Mapping with Rotating LiDAR and Panoramic Vision](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.17351){.project-title}
[Co-first Author, IEEE RA-L (SCI Q2 TOP, Under Review)]{.project-date}
:::
::: {.project-desc}
To address the lack of spatial reasoning capabilities in LLMs and the issue of context explosion within large-scale 3D environments, we developed an omnidirectional perception-driven embodied AI agent framework using Python, PyTorch, and ROS 2. The front-end integrates rotating LiDAR and panoramic vision to construct a five-layer dynamic scene graph, utilizing persistent homology-based adaptive room segmentation and VLM-based hybrid pruning. At the decision-making level, we pioneered the use of 3D 8-neighbor connectivity and multi-resolution spatial attention prompting to achieve zero-shot long-range navigation; this resulted in a 93.18% success rate (with a 22.73% improvement in viewpoint-dependent accuracy) and a 69.98% reduction in token costs.
:::
